title: Yemen: Houthis left in control of land overlooking the Bab el-Mandeb strait
caption:
Saudi-backed southern forces in Yemen said on Sunday they were withdrawing from Dhubab airport and the Bab el-Mandeb area to defend Aden, leaving the Iran-aligned Houthis in control of territory overlooking the strait. The waterway links the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden and is a key route for global shipping. The Houthis have been attacking Saudi Arabia as part of the wider war with Iran.
